name: Hotaru no haka
why: Takahata's film, proposed under its Japanese title. JustWatch UK's search for the Japanese name leads with the 2005 live-action remake, which the year rule rightly refuses, and the 1988 page is filed as Grave of the Fireflies at /uk/movie/grave-of-the-fireflies-1988.

name: Dekalog
why: Kieślowski's ten films, proposed under both names (candidates-20.json as Dekalog, cand-c40-r3.json as The Decalogue). The UK page is filed as Dekalog; the English name is what an English list writes, and is the one to try if the Polish one ever stops resolving.
